detail: The F1A start receipt exists, but this scheduled continuation does not expose the prior F1A-generated image as a file or exact-byte asset. The current conversation file surface contains only unrelated pre-existing PNGs, not an F1A model-generated artifact. Persisting the prior image would therefore require reconstruction, re-rendering, screenshotting, conversion, owner upload, or another transfer mechanism, all of which are prohibited by the F1B contract.
